title: Conditionals (Type 1 & Type 2): Real Plans vs. Hypothetical Scenarios
subtitle: CEFR B1–B2 • Likely Future Outcomes vs. Imagined Present Alternatives

topics.title: 1. First Conditional (Real & Likely Future)
topics.subtitle: If + Simple Present → Will + Verb-1
topics.explanation: Digunakan untuk merencanakan skenario nyata yang sangat mungkin terjadi di masa depan beserta konsekuensinya ('Jika syarat A terpenuhi nanti, maka hasil B akan terjadi').
topics.rationale: Meskipun merujuk masa depan, klausa setelah 'If' memakai Simple Present sebagai syarat, sedangkan klausa hasil memakai 'will/can/should + V1'.

formulas.pattern: If + Subject + Simple Present, Subject + will ('ll) / can + Verb-1
If + Subject + don't/doesn't + V1, Subject + won't + Verb-1
What will + Subject + do + if + Subject + Simple Present?

conditionalExamples.positive: If all integration tests pass, we'll deploy to production tonight.
conditionalExamples.negative: If we don't optimize the images, the page won't load fast on mobile.
conditionalExamples.question: What will happen if the API rate limit exceeds 1,000 requests?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Skenario ini realistis dan sedang diperhitungkan secara aktif.

specialExceptions.title: Dilarang Memakai 'Will' Setelah 'If' (atau 'When / As soon as')
specialExceptions.explanation: Kata penghubung waktu dan syarat (if, when, as soon as, before, until) selalu diikuti Simple Present, bukan 'will'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the outdoor event.
specialExceptions.correctExample: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the outdoor event.

tipsAndTricks: Kata 'unless' berarti 'if... not' (Unless we cache the data = If we don't cache the data).

topics.title: 2. Second Conditional (Imaginary & Hypothetical)
topics.subtitle: If + Simple Past → Would + Verb-1
topics.explanation: Digunakan untuk membayangkan situasi yang tidak nyata sekarang, berandai-andai tentang kondisi berbeda, atau memberikan saran secara diplomatis ('Seandainya saja sekarang..., maka aku akan...').
topics.rationale: Bentuk lampau (Verb-2 / were) di sini bukan menunjukkan waktu masa lalu, melainkan 'jarak psikologis' dari kenyataan saat ini.

formulas.pattern: If + Subject + Simple Past (V2 / were), Subject + would ('d) / could + V1
If + Subject + didn't + V1 / weren't, Subject + wouldn't + V1
What would + Subject + do + if + Subject + Simple Past?

conditionalExamples.positive: If we had a larger budget, we would build native iOS and Android apps.
conditionalExamples.negative: If I were you, I wouldn't rewrite the entire backend from scratch.
conditionalExamples.question: What would you change if you redesigned the onboarding flow?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Faktanya saat ini budget terbatas, sehingga kita membayangkan skenario alternatif dengan 'had' dan 'would'.

xrayTokens.nuance: Frasa standar B2 untuk memberi saran halus ('Kalau aku jadi kamu...')

specialExceptions.title: Gunakan 'Were' untuk Semua Subjek dalam Pengandaian Formal
specialExceptions.explanation: Dalam Second Conditional, 'If I were...', 'If he were...', dan 'If it were...' dianggap standar emas dibandingkan 'was'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: If I was the product owner, I would prioritize usability.
specialExceptions.correctExample: If I were the product owner, I would prioritize usability.

tipsAndTricks: Perbedaan rasa: 'If I win' (kamu yakin punya peluang besar menang) vs. 'If I won' (kamu hanya berandai-andai iseng).

scenario.interlocutor: Rekanmu ragu apakah harus menghapus database lama hari ini tanpa backup
scenario.intent: Memberikan saran pencegahan menggunakan pola pengandaian halus.

practiceQuiz.question: Kalimat mana yang paling natural dan gramatikal?

options.text: If I were you, I wouldn't drop that table without a backup.
If I am you, I won't drop that table without a backup.
If I would be you, I didn't drop that table without a backup.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: Karena aku mustahil menjadi dirimu (situasi imajiner), gunakan Second Conditional: 'If I were you, I wouldn't + V1'.
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A memakai First Conditional untuk hal yang mustahil, dan Opsi C menukar posisi 'would' dan past tense.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Hafalkan satu paket: 'If I were you, I'd + V1' sebagai senjata saran paling sopan dalam bahasa Inggris.
